title: Solution, frontend, e2e, and local-infrastructure scaffold
objective: Bootstrap the repository so every later task has a building, testable skeleton: .NET 10 solution, React SPA, Playwright project, and local docker-compose infrastructure (PostgreSQL, Keycloak, Vault, MinIO).
scope: Create src/api solution with projects QuoteIQ.Api, QuoteIQ.Application, QuoteIQ.Domain, QuoteIQ.Infrastructure (file-scoped namespaces, nullable enabled) and xUnit test projects under src/api/tests: QuoteIQ.Api.Tests, QuoteIQ.Application.Tests, QuoteIQ.Domain.Tests, QuoteIQ.Infrastructure.Tests
Wire Serilog at host level, Cortex.Mediator registration in Application DI extension (AddApplication), Infrastructure DI extension (AddInfrastructure)
Health endpoint GET /health (anonymous) as first minimal-API endpoint mapping pattern under Api/Endpoints
Create src/ui Vite React 18 + TypeScript strict app with Redux Toolkit store skeleton and npm scripts: dev, build, typecheck (tsc --noEmit), test
Create e2e_tests Playwright TypeScript project with config pointing at local app URL and one smoke spec (health/login page reachable)
Create docker-compose.yml at repo root with services: postgres:17, keycloak:26, hashicorp/vault (dev mode), minio; named volumes; healthchecks

Create Liquibase wiring: src/api/db/changelog/db.changelog-master.xml plus liquibase.properties template and a compose 'liquibase' one-shot service (or documented CLI command) that applies the changelog
README.dev.md documenting: compose up, liquibase update, dotnet run, npm dev, test commands
out_of_scope: Any business tables, entities, or endpoints beyond /health
Vault secret reading (T-002), Keycloak realm content (T-004)
implementation_details: Solution file src/api/QuoteIQ.sln; project references: Api -> Application + Infrastructure; Infrastructure -> Application + Domain; Application -> Domain

QuoteIQ.Api/Program.cs: WebApplicationBuilder with Serilog (ReadFrom.Configuration), AddApplication(), AddInfrastructure(configuration), MapEndpoints() convention that discovers IEndpoint implementations (simple static registration list, no reflection magic)
Directory.Build.props under src/api setting TargetFramework net10.0, Nullable enable, TreatWarningsAsErrors true, LangVersion latest
NuGet baseline: Cortex.Mediator, Serilog.AspNetCore, Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL (referenced now, used from T-003), FluentValidation

src/ui: Vite react-ts template; eslint + prettier config; tsconfig strict true, noUncheckedIndexedAccess true; folder layout src/app (store), src/api (client placeholder), src/features, src/components, src/theme
e2e_tests: @playwright/test, playwright.config.ts with baseURL http://localhost:5173, webServer entries commented until app runs; smoke.spec.ts asserting the dev server serves the app shell

docker-compose.yml ports: postgres 5432, keycloak 8080, vault 8200, minio 9000/9001; postgres init creates database quoteiq; minio entrypoint creates bucket quoteiq-attachments via mc in a sidecar init container
Liquibase master changelog includes an empty 000-baseline changeset so 'liquibase update' succeeds on the empty database

integration: Solution builds and dotnet test passes across all four test projects
Liquibase update applies cleanly against compose postgres (empty baseline)
e2e: smoke.spec.ts: dev server serves the SPA root

findings.summary: Keycloak healthcheck in docker-compose.yml can never succeed
findings.detail: docker-compose.yml keycloak healthcheck probes localhost:8080/health/ready, but keycloak:26 disables health endpoints unless KC_HEALTH_ENABLED=true and serves them on the management interface port 9000, not 8080. Container stays permanently unhealthy/starting; any future depends_on condition service_healthy (T-004) would hang. Fix: add KC_HEALTH_ENABLED true to keycloak environment and probe management port 9000 /health/ready (e.g., bash /dev/tcp probe), or use a plain TCP-connect check on 8080. CONFIRMED LIVE by infra evaluator: 8080/health/ready returns 404, port 9000 refuses connections (management interface not started), container ends 'running (unhealthy)' after start_period+retries. Fix alongside: Keycloak 26 logs deprecation warning for KEYCLOAK_ADMIN/KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD; rename to KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME/KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD.

findings.summary: No dev-only warning comment on hardcoded compose credentials
findings.detail: docker-compose.yml contains local dev credentials (quoteiq/quoteiq, admin/admin, quoteiq-dev-root, quoteiq123) without a local-dev-only warning comment. CLAUDE.md permits local-dev secrets only with warnings. Fix: add a warning comment in docker-compose.yml.
